title: Soup on the Later Platform
story: Rafi reached the harbour station with his ticket in his coat and a few minutes to spare. The board then showed that his train had been cancelled because of a fault on the line. A clerk said the next direct service would leave from another platform in nearly two hours. He stayed inside in case the board changed, bought a cheap bowl of soup, and kept his paper map ready. While he waited, he checked that the guesthouse would still hold his room if he arrived after dark. The owner replied that a coded box by the door would hold the key, and that the street was quiet but well lit. Rafi sent his sister the new time so she would not worry. When the later train came, he boarded with an empty cup and the map folded the right way up. The delay had cost him daylight, but he was still going.
